svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Atlas Infra view (⌥4), Capacity layer, cluster prod-eu-1 in 3D (INC-2041)
svg.desc: Infra view of cluster prod-eu-1 at ladder level L2 with the Capacity layer on. Node pools stand as rows of plinths: general, memory, gpu and system, each labelled on the floor. Every node is a transparent glass box whose height is its allocatable memory; a translucent blue fill level shows the memory requested by its pods and stacked opaque blocks show each pod's memory in use, so headroom reads as the empty glass above the stack. Healthy nodes are neutral grey. Node ip-10-4-9-17 in pool memory is overcommitted under MemoryPressure: the batch-etl block (2.4× its request) is drawn swollen and bulges out of the top and sides of the glass in Degraded amber. Node ip-10-4-3-12, which hosts the psp-api client pods of payments, glows Failing with the ⊕ origin beacon; a checkout victim node carries a dashed ring. A height ruler marks 0.5×, 1.0× and 1.25× allocatable. Docked 2D: a strip with the selected node's memory over the last hour (used, request, allocatable, OOMKilled marks, ⚙ 12:19 and ⚠ 12:22) and a side panel with pool headroom bars. HUD: top bar, view switcher with Infra active, layer chips with Capacity active, Orbit · Map · Fly chip, altitude ladder with L2 lit, cluster header strip, minimap, orbit gizmo and the Time Ribbon.
